docs.description: And here we are again. It's FREAKY FRIDAY at the electro Space Rock Opera, with Sonica the Radar Sonic Girl Bat! Wow, the time went fast this week here in our  Block Universe where the past, present, and future all exist at the same time. LOL! Thats true though. Music by Lenny Lionstar the Space Lion (I'm human) and AI Viper the Venom Siren Gear (Not human) Vocals by Venus Xlatross (half human) Peace and love Everyone. Have a fun weekend! Stay safe. Master Jack says It's a strange world we live in. Full Cyber-LP - "Waiting for the Afterlife Bus - Supernatural Gears : Lenny Wiles Lionstar : Free Download, Borrow, and Streaming : Internet Archive" ( https://archive.org/details/01-drac-girl-lenny-lionstar-the-space-lion )  Space Opera: Sonica the Radar Sonic Girl Bat Sonica the Radar Sonic Girl Bat. She's a  Supernatural Minstrel Siren Gear Singer of the Blood Moon Music Minstrel Guild. She sings using supernatural sonic bat radar sound waves to trance Reptilian Drac crew members with her beautiful magical singing causing them to guide their War Starships to crash land safely on planets. There they are captured and their brains are embeded with empathy mind chips where they then experience extreme sadness and empathy for all the death and destruction they've caused across the universe. They are then sent back to the Draco Constellation Sector. Sonica also consumes dangerous poisonous insectoid clontrons flying around at night on Planet X her home planet.  She sometimes travels on Supernatural Minstrel Gear missions with Lenny Lionstar the Space Lion and AI Viper the Venom Siren Gear. Currently she is traveling to the Alien landing at Hilltop in Hex County Pennsylvania as the Perfect Paranormal Storm will strike the area in 2028 in the Countdown to Singularity. LYRICS:  (Verse 1) Planet X is shadowed in the neon-purple gloom, Dangerous, toxic clontrons buzzing in the Blood Moon. With a flick of my leather wing and a snap of my fangs, I hunt the stinging swarm where the dark ether hangs. I swallow the venom, I swallow the blight, A creature of radar in the pitch of the night. But my duty calls higher than the smog of this sphere, To the Guild of the Minstrel, the Warden of the Ear. (Pre-Chorus) With Lenny Space Lion, brave in his mane, And AI Viper hissing through the stellar-wind rain, We ride on the gear of the supernatural band, As the prophecy wakes in the Pennsylvania land. (Chorus) Oh, I am Sonica, the Radar Sonic Girl! A siren of the Blood Moon, spinning out the world! I sing the high frequency, the ultrasonic wave, That turns the Reptilian War Ships to the grave. They drop from the cosmos, they follow the tune, Guided safely to earth by the light of the moon! No laser, no missile, just the magic of my voice, Making the Dracs weep and repent of their choice! (Verse 2) They descended from the stars in their terror and scale, Thinking iron and plasma would always prevail. But my song hits their sensors, a mesmerizing trance, A hypnotic echolocation in a heavy metal dance. I weave through the radar, a bat in the sky, As the Draconian crew watches all their conquests die. We guide their huge War Stars to a feather soft land, Where the traps of the guild await in the sand. (Bridge) And down in the labs, the surgery begins— We extract the cold heart of their interstellar sins. We embed the empathy chips deep inside of each brain, And flood their flat synapses with sorrow and pain. They feel every life that they crushed in the past, The weight of the universe catching up at last! Extreme floods of mercy, and tears for the dead, As the guilt of destruction takes hold of their head. Then we turn their ships back to the Draco array, Remind them of peace as they slither away! (Verse 3) Now the stardust is gathering, the cosmos aligns, Marking the epoch, the end of the signs. We set our coordinates, locking the gear, Bound for the Alien landing at Hilltop, right here! In Hex County, Pennsylvania, the shadows grow deep, Where the secrets of ages are buried asleep. The Perfect Paranormal Storm is brewing ahead, In 2028, where the timeline is tread. (Outro) The Countdown to Singularity is ticking the clock, As the mountains of Hex County shatter and rock. Lenny roars loud, AI Viper strikes true, And I tune up my vocal cords, brand new. Listen close to the echo... watch the radar gleam... I’m Sonica the Bat Girl... ...and you’re caught in my dream. space opera, sci fi, future pop, aiart, Human AI, aigenerated, fantasy art, original, music strange music, bat girl, york pa aliens,
